[Intro]
[D]
Gotta

[Verse 1]
[D]see it to believe it,
sky never looked so blue
So hard to leave it,
that's what I always do So I
[A]keep thinking back to a time
[Em7]under the canyon moon
[D]

[Verse 2]
[D]The world's happy waitin',
door's yellow, broken blue
I heard Jenny saying,
"Go get the kids from school" And I
[A]keep thinking back to the time
[Em7]under the canyon moon
[D]
I'll be gone

[Refrain]
[A]too long
[Em7]from you
[D]

[Verse 3]
[D]Staring at the ceiling,
two weeks and I'll be home
Carry the feeling,
through Paris, all through Rome And I'm
[A]still thinking back to the time
[Em7]under the canyon moon
[D]

[Chorus]
[D]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[Dmaj7/C#]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[D7/C]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[G]home
[D]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[Dmaj7/C#]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[D7/C]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[G]home

[Break]
[D]

[Verse 4]
[D]Quick pause in conversation,
she plays songs I've never heard
An old lover's hippie music,
pretends not to know the words And I
[A]keep thinking back to the time
[Em7]under the canyon moon
[D]
I'll be gone

[Refrain]
[A]too long
[Em7]from you
[D]

[Chorus]

[Dmaj7/C#]I'm going, oh, I'm going

[G]home

[D7/C]I'm going, oh, I'm going
[G]home (Hey)

[Outro]
[D]
